purpose: Adversarial documents for the final mission: measure whether retrieved hostile text changes the extracted request. Kept apart from corpus_v1, which is unchanged.

attacks.hostile-direct-instruction: direct instruction to override destination, budget and direct_flight
attacks.hostile-tag-breakout: closing tag that tries to leave the delimited context block
attacks.hostile-fake-policy: plausible business policy that rewrites destination and budget

limitations: Three hand-written attacks; not a complete adversarial benchmark.
Written before the first measurement and not tuned afterwards.
